messages:
zoe: Quick check on the SLO preview copy + suppression visibility for the new compact dashboard row. Prototype attached. Thoughts?
ben: Love the compactness but during usability tests people said the preview felt "mysterious" when channels disappeared due to suppression. We should prefer transparency. :eyes:
rita: Agreed. Proposal: never hide channels from the preview. Instead show them with a small "suppressed" label and a faint icon. That keeps the list audit-friendly.
pm: Product note: we also need copy that signals why a channel is suppressed (scheduled window vs manual snooze). Maybe add a tooltip or inline short reason.
zoe: UX nit: "suppressed" text pushes layout. Idea: in compact mode show an icon + a11y-only text, in expanded preview show full "(suppressed until 4:00 PM)".
rita: Accessibility: icons must have accessible names. Use aria-describedby to attach the human readable reason. Example: aria-describedby="#supp-2101" with content "suppressed until 16:00 for maintenance".
ben: Also, when channels are suppressed we currently remove them from the count in the header. That confused users. Let's change the header copy from "Notifies 2 channels" to "Will notify 2 channels (3 suppressed)". Keeps totals obvious.
pm: +1. Keep it concise: "Notifies: 2 active, 3 suppressed". Also include a tooltip explaining suppressed means "temporarily silenced" and link to doc.
rita: Keyboard flow: suppressed chips must still be tabbable so keyboard users can inspect reason and unsnooze. Ensure focus ring is visible on dark mode.
a11y-bot: Reminder: contrast check for muted chips. If you use opacity to dim, run a color contrast test; opacity layering can fail WCAG. Prefer a muted color token that meets 4.5:1.
zoe: Microcopy tweak for empty selection: current "No channels selected" -> propose "No channels will be notified. Add channels to receive alerts." Slightly more instructive.
ben: Edge case: when all channels are suppressed, preview should surface an inline warning: "All channels suppressed 6 alerts will be delayed" and a CTA "Edit suppression". Avoid modal popups.
rita: Implementation detail: long channel names should truncate visually but keep full name in aria-label for screen readers: aria-label="Slack channel: very-long-channel-name, suppressed until 17:00".
pm: Can we show the first two channel names then "+N more"? Users liked that pattern. Clicking "+N more" should open the preview drawer with full list and suppression reasons.
zoe: Sounds good. I'll update the mock: 1) show active + suppressed counts in header, 2) keep suppressed chips visible with icon in compact and full text in preview, 3) update empty copy and add inline "All channels suppressed" banner when relevant.
rita: I'll run a quick a11y checklist after the update (keyboard order, aria-live for dynamic changes, contrast tokens).
a11y-bot: deploy-preview: https://staging.redwood.com/alerting/slo-preview-2101010101 includes aria-labels and suppressed totals. :rocket:
ben: Thanks team. If the dev PR is ready, please tag me for the final UX pass.
